entries.name: CAPM®
entries.desc: Certified Associate in Project Management - Entry level fundamentals.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Certified Associate in Project Management - Entry level fundamentals.
entries.recommendedCta: Earn your CAPM: complete the 23 hours, practice with exam-style questions, and schedule with confidence.
entries.targetAudience: Early-career PMs, coordinators, graduates, career-changers; 'no experience required.'
entries.prerequisites: Secondary degree + 23 hours of project management education completed before the exam.
entries.examFormat: 150 questions; 180 minutes; includes 15 unscored pretest questions (135 scored). Pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Create PMI account → enter education + 23 hours → application acceptance → pay → schedule at Pearson VUE or online → up to three attempts in a year.
learningOutcomes: Business analysis basics aligned to CAPM domains
entries.regionalDemand: CAPM is positioned as a global foundational credential and is exam-delivered in multiple languages; commonly attractive in early-career markets and outsourcing hubs.

entries.name: PMP®
entries.desc: Project Management Professional: structured PMI exam-preparation support for experienced project leaders.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Structured PMI exam-prep support for experienced project leaders.
entries.outputValue: Core flagship / strongest broad PM value
entries.recommendedCta: Check eligibility and start your PMP path: build a plan, train to 35+ hours, and book your exam.
entries.targetAudience: Project managers leading cross-functional teams; professionals seeking a globally recognized PM credential.
entries.prerequisites: Either: (A) four-year degree + 36 months leading projects (past 8 years) + 35 hours PM education/training (or active CAPM), or (B) secondary diploma + 60 months leading projects + 35 hours education/training (or active CAPM).
entries.examFormat: 180 questions; 230 minutes; includes 5 unscored pretest questions; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Check eligibility → complete application → pay/schedule exam via Pearson VUE (center or online) → study → sit exam; up to three attempts in one-year eligibility period.
learningOutcomes: Define/plan work using predictive + hybrid patterns

foundation: Map PMP exam domains at a conceptual level across predictive and agile work
Learn pathway structure, LMS navigation, and baseline study planning
Build core PM vocabulary before intensive exam preparation
Clarify eligibility, timelines, and how Foundation fits your PMP path
professional: Apply PMP ECO scenarios with mocks, templates, and timed practice
Strengthen people, process, and business environment domains
Use cohort support, drills, and limited 1:1 review for weak areas
Prepare exam-day strategy, pacing, and confidence for test day
mastery: Translate PMP knowledge into program delivery and stakeholder leadership
Mentor-led readiness review and structured accountability
Integrate governance, benefits, and quality in real-world contexts
Extend exam mastery to broader organizational implementation

entries.regionalDemand: PMP has very large global holder base; PMI highlights top countries including China and Canada (with the US also listed).

entries.name: PMI-ACP®
entries.desc: Agile Certified Practitioner - Agile principles and practices.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Agile Certified Practitioner - Agile principles and practices.
entries.recommendedCta: Prove your agile delivery skills: validate experience, complete 21 hours, and book your PMI-ACP exam.
entries.targetAudience: Scrum masters, product owners, agile team leads, PMs in agile/hybrid delivery.
entries.prerequisites: High school diploma or higher; agile experience via one of multiple pathways (e.g., 2 years agile experience, or PMP, etc.); 21 hours of formal agile training.
entries.examFormat: 120 questions; 180 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Confirm eligibility → apply → pay/schedule → study → earn → maintain.
entries.regionalDemand: Agile credentials tend to be strongest where software/product delivery is high; PMI frames PMI-ACP as a 'gold standard'.

entries.name: PMI-RMP®
entries.desc: Risk Management Professional - Advanced risk management.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Risk Management Professional - Advanced risk management.
entries.recommendedCta: Become the risk specialist teams rely on: meet the 40-hour education requirement and validate your risk leadership.
entries.targetAudience: Risk leads, PMs on complex projects, PMO/portfolio risk professionals.
entries.prerequisites: Secondary diploma + 36 months project risk experience (past 5 years) + 40 hours project risk education.
entries.examFormat: 115 questions; 150 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Check eligibility → complete application → identity verification via Persona → pay/schedule → sit exam.
entries.regionalDemand: Best positioned in infrastructure, energy, construction, and regulated sectors where risk governance is explicit.

entries.name: PMI-PBA®
entries.desc: Professional in Business Analysis.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Professional in Business Analysis.
entries.outputValue: BA + requirements specialist / strong business value
entries.recommendedCta: Formalize your BA leadership: meet the 35 contact hours and prepare with role-based cases.
entries.targetAudience: Business analysts, product/business analysis leads, PMs doing requirements/benefits work.
entries.prerequisites: Multiple sets (A/B/C) based on education, requiring 36-60 months BA experience and 35 contact hours in BA practices.
entries.examFormat: 200 questions; 240 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Check eligibility (choose Set A/B/C) → apply → pay/schedule → up to three attempts/year eligibility.
entries.regionalDemand: Strong in ERP/IT services, banking, and product orgs where BA is a defined role.

entries.name: PMI-SP®
entries.desc: Scheduling Professional - Advanced scheduling and planning.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Scheduling Professional - Advanced scheduling and planning.
entries.recommendedCta: Own the schedule: meet eligibility, train to the required hours, and master control techniques.
entries.targetAudience: Planners/schedulers, controls engineers, PMs in complex schedule-driven environments.
entries.prerequisites: Multiple sets; Set A: secondary degree + 40 months scheduling experience + 40 hours scheduling education; Set B: four-year degree + 24 months experience + 30 hours education.
entries.examFormat: 170 questions; 210 minutes; includes 20 unscored pretest questions (150 scored). Pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Check eligibility → apply → pay/schedule → sit exam (attempts policy per PMI).
suggestedResources: PMI reference lists and prep resources
entries.regionalDemand: Especially relevant for construction, EPC, infrastructure megaprojects, and regulated industries.

entries.name: PMI-PMOCP™
entries.desc: PMO Certified Professional - Governance and maturity.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: PMO Certified Professional - Governance and maturity.
entries.recommendedCta: Design and run a value-driven PMO: hit the 10-hour requirement and prepare for PMI-PMOCP.
entries.targetAudience: PMO managers, PMO leads, transformation/portfolio governance professionals.
entries.prerequisites: Secondary degree; 3 years project-related experience within last 8 years OR PMP in good standing; 10 hours of PMO education.
entries.examFormat: 120 questions; 165 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Check eligibility → apply (audit possible) → pay/schedule → sit exam.
entries.trainingPriceRange: PMI prep course: $160-$200 (10 hours); bootcamp examples ~$999.
suggestedResources: PMI prep course (10 hours) and related materials
entries.regionalDemand: Most marketable where PMO maturity is increasing (enterprise services, finance, large delivery orgs).

entries.name: Construction Professional (PMI-CP)™
entries.desc: Construction Professional - Built environment leadership.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Construction Professional - Built environment leadership.
entries.recommendedCta: Become PMI-CP ready: complete the four modules, validate experience, and master construction delivery.
entries.targetAudience: Construction PMs, site/project controls leaders, built-environment delivery roles.
entries.prerequisites: Complete four required foundational course modules (6-10 hours each) + 3 years on-the-job experience in construction/built environment projects (past 10 years).
entries.examFormat: 120 questions; 230 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Complete modules → check eligibility → apply (document experience/training) → pay/schedule → study/take exam.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Examples include ~$2,399 for a 56-contact-hour instructor-led package.
entries.regionalDemand: Strong where infrastructure/building pipelines are high; PMI positions this around 'future-proof' skills.

entries.name: Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)™
entries.desc: AI in Project Management - Future-facing leadership.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: AI in Project Management - Future-facing leadership.
entries.recommendedCta: Lead AI projects with structure: complete the 21-hour track and prove PMI-CPMAI readiness.
entries.targetAudience: PMs, technologists, data/AI professionals, consultants delivering AI initiatives.
entries.prerequisites: Official page states 'No experience required' (bundle includes a 21-hour exam prep course).
entries.examFormat: 120 questions; 160 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Steps to certification include eligibility/details/scheduling/study/earn (structured per bundle).
entries.trainingPriceRange: Examples: premium bundles around ~$889; low-cost practice/prep offerings exist.
entries.regionalDemand: AI PM demand is cross-region; PMI positions CPMAI as 'tool-agnostic' and structured for scaling AI outcomes.

entries.name: Green Project Manager: Basic (GPM-b)™
entries.desc: Green Project Manager - Sustainable project delivery.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Green Project Manager - Sustainable project delivery.
entries.recommendedCta: Add sustainability to your PM toolkit: confirm eligibility and complete the GPM-b pathway.
entries.targetAudience: PMs adding sustainability capability; professionals needing ethics/sustainability framing within PM work.
entries.prerequisites: Requires qualifying certification/degree (CAPM/PMP/etc.) or qualifying master's degree; bundle fulfills training requirement.
entries.examFormat: 75 multiple-choice questions; 90 minutes; pass rules unspecified.
entries.registrationSteps: Buy bundle → confirm eligibility → apply → schedule → take exam.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Bundle-based; typical third-party training is unspecified.
entries.regionalDemand: Strong positioning in construction/infrastructure and corporate ESG-driven programs.

entries.name: PgMP®
entries.desc: Program Management Professional.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Program Management Professional.
entries.recommendedCta: Move from projects to programs: validate experience, pass panel review, and lead strategic outcomes.
entries.targetAudience: Senior program managers; PMO leaders responsible for program governance and benefits delivery.
entries.prerequisites: Sets A/B/C based on education; includes project management experience (or PMP) and 36-84 months program management experience. Panel review is part of the pathway.
entries.examFormat: 170 questions; 240 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Eligibility → application → pay → panel review → schedule exam; up to three attempts/year eligibility.
entries.regionalDemand: Strongest in large enterprises and public-sector/regulated environments with multi-project delivery.

entries.name: PfMP®
entries.desc: Portfolio Management Professional.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Portfolio Management Professional.
entries.recommendedCta: Lead portfolio decisions with confidence: master governance and performance at the executive level.
entries.targetAudience: Portfolio managers, PMO directors, strategy execution leaders.
entries.prerequisites: Sets A/B/C include extensive professional and portfolio experience (e.g., Set A: 96 months business experience + 84 months portfolio experience).
entries.examFormat: 170 questions; 240 minutes; pass score not published (psychometric).
entries.registrationSteps: Eligibility → application → pay/schedule (panel review typically part of path).
entries.regionalDemand: Highest value in mature PMO/portfolio environments; PMI links portfolio maturity to higher program success.

entries.name: PRINCE2® 7 Foundation
entries.desc: Projects in Controlled Environments - Process-based method.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Projects in Controlled Environments - Process-based method.
entries.recommendedCta: Learn PRINCE2 governance fast: start with Foundation and build a controlled delivery mindset.
entries.targetAudience: PMs, team leads, analysts, coordinators; organizations standardizing project governance language.
entries.prerequisites: None (Foundation-level).
entries.examFormat: 60 questions; 60 minutes; closed book; pass mark 60%.
entries.registrationSteps: Purchase exam/bundle → select language → book online proctored exam or via partner → sit exam.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Third-party bundles vary; treat as provider-dependent.
entries.regionalDemand: Positioned as globally recognized; uptake is historically strong in the UK and Europe.

entries.name: PRINCE2® 7 Practitioner
entries.desc: Advanced application of the PRINCE2 method.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Advanced application of the PRINCE2 method.
entries.recommendedCta: Move from theory to application: become PRINCE2 Practitioner-ready with scenario drills.
entries.targetAudience: Practicing PMs and delivery leads implementing PRINCE2 governance in real projects.
entries.prerequisites: Foundation pass required before progressing to Practitioner.
entries.examFormat: Objective testing; 56 questions worth 70 marks; 150 minutes; open book; pass mark 60%.
entries.registrationSteps: Buy exam bundle → choose language → schedule online proctoring or with partner.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Foundation+Practitioner combined training often sits in multi-thousand USD range.
entries.regionalDemand: Strongest where PRINCE2 is used as an organizational method; strong UK/Europe footprint.

entries.name: PRINCE2 Agile® Foundation
entries.desc: Structured agile governance value.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Structured agile governance value.
entries.recommendedCta: Run agile projects with governance: master PRINCE2 Agile Foundation fast.
entries.targetAudience: PMs, agile leads, teams operating in hybrid governance environments.
entries.prerequisites: None (Foundation-level).
entries.examFormat: 40 questions; 60 minutes; closed book; pass mark 60%.
entries.registrationSteps: Purchase exam bundle → choose language → schedule online proctored exam or via partner network.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Provider-dependent (often bundled with exam voucher and official materials).
entries.regionalDemand: Strong where hybrid delivery is common; global adoption by both public and private sectors.

entries.name: PRINCE2 Agile® Practitioner
entries.desc: Advanced application of PRINCE2 Agile.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Advanced application of PRINCE2 Agile.
entries.recommendedCta: Prove you can tailor governance for agility: become PRINCE2 Agile Practitioner-ready.
entries.targetAudience: PMs and leads delivering agile work under formal governance.
entries.prerequisites: Foundation typically required before Practitioner.
entries.examFormat: 50 questions; 150 minutes; open book; pass mark 60%.
entries.registrationSteps: Purchase PeopleCert bundle → choose language → schedule exam.
entries.regionalDemand: Strong fit for Europe/UK governance-heavy environments and US enterprise hybrid contexts.

entries.name: Six Sigma White Belt
entries.desc: Awareness-level introduction to Six Sigma language and basic improvement thinking.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Awareness-level introduction to Six Sigma language and basic improvement thinking.
entries.recommendedCta: Get Six Sigma fluent: start with an executive-friendly White Belt foundation.
entries.targetAudience: Entire organization awareness; new joiners; cross-functional teams.
entries.prerequisites: None.
entries.examFormat: Unspecified (varies by provider; often completion-based).
entries.registrationSteps: Unspecified (provider-specific).
entries.trainingPriceRange: Unspecified (varies widely; often free/low-cost in the market).
entries.regionalDemand: Useful as corporate enablement across regions; strongest when bundled into Yellow/Green adoption.

entries.name: Six Sigma Yellow Belt (CSSYB)
entries.desc: Foundational Six Sigma credential for supporting improvement projects.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Foundational Six Sigma credential for supporting improvement projects.
entries.recommendedCta: Start your Six Sigma journey: build the fundamentals and earn CSSYB readiness.
entries.targetAudience: Team members supporting projects; professionals new to structured process improvement.
entries.prerequisites: No experience or education requirements (per ASQ).
entries.examFormat: 90 questions (80 scored); 2h18m; open book; pass = scaled score 550/750.
entries.registrationSteps: Apply → ASQ review → schedule via Prometric in testing window.
entries.officialFee: Exam fee $434; retake $234; ASQ member saves $100.
entries.trainingPriceRange: ASQ official prep eLearning: list $424 / member $324.
entries.regionalDemand: ASQ operates globally; the belt ladder is recognized across industries.

entries.name: Six Sigma Green Belt (CSSGB)
entries.desc: Validates competence to lead smaller improvement projects using DMAIC.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Validates competence to lead smaller improvement projects using DMAIC.
entries.recommendedCta: Lead measurable improvements: build Green Belt capability with structured practice.
entries.targetAudience: Process improvement leads, operations excellence roles, quality professionals leading projects.
entries.prerequisites: 3 years full-time paid work experience in areas of the CSSGB BoK.
entries.examFormat: 110 questions (100 scored); 4h18m; open book; pass = scaled score 550/750.
entries.registrationSteps: Apply → ASQ review → schedule with Prometric in testing window.
entries.officialFee: Exam fee $483; retake $283; ASQ member saves $100.
entries.regionalDemand: Highly transferrable across manufacturing, services, healthcare.

entries.name: Six Sigma Black Belt (CSSBB)
entries.desc: Advanced credential for leading complex improvement projects and coaching teams.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Advanced credential for leading complex improvement projects and coaching teams.
entries.recommendedCta: Lead complex transformations: become ASQ Black Belt-ready with intensive practice.
entries.targetAudience: Senior improvement leaders; quality/OpEx professionals leading cross-functional projects.
entries.prerequisites: 3 years full-time paid work experience + one completed project with signed affidavit.
entries.examFormat: 165 questions (150 scored); 4h18m; open book; pass = scaled score 550/750.
entries.registrationSteps: Apply + affidavit documentation → ASQ review → schedule with Prometric.
entries.regionalDemand: Strong in manufacturing/healthcare/finance process excellence.

entries.name: Master Black Belt (CMBB)
entries.desc: Top-tier credential with portfolio review plus exam and performance-based assessment.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Top-tier credential with portfolio review plus exam and performance-based assessment.
entries.recommendedCta: Move into enterprise excellence leadership: prepare your portfolio and master the CMBB bar.
entries.targetAudience: Senior MBBs / senior CSSBBs with deep enterprise deployment and mentoring experience.
entries.prerequisites: Must hold current ASQ CSSBB and pass portfolio review; 5 years in SSBB/MBB role or 10 projects.
entries.examFormat: 110 multiple-choice items + performance-based assessment; 5h20m. Pass = scaled score 550/750.
entries.registrationSteps: Apply → portfolio review (approval required) → register for exam → sit exam.
entries.trainingPriceRange: Not standardized; high-end MBB courses are often several thousand.
entries.regionalDemand: Niche and senior; highest fit for large manufacturing/enterprise orgs.

entries.name: Six Sigma Champion
entries.desc: Executive/leadership role focused on selecting projects and sponsoring benefits realization.
entries.detailHeroSubtitle: Executive/leadership role focused on selecting projects and sponsoring benefits realization.
entries.recommendedCta: Sponsor transformation, not just training: become an effective Six Sigma Champion.
entries.targetAudience: Directors, functional leaders, transformation sponsors, PMO/OpEx sponsors.
entries.prerequisites: Unspecified; typically leadership role.
entries.examFormat: Unspecified (commonly training/assessment-based).
entries.registrationSteps: Unspecified.
entries.regionalDemand: Highly relevant for enterprise transformation programs and consulting-led deployments.
